key.name: city-plate
key.description: Turkish licence-plate code of the city, as used by the prayer-time data files. 6 is Ankara.

key.name: primary-clock
key.summary: Which clock is the large one
key.description: "alaturka" or "normal". The other one is shown small beneath it.

key.name: hijri-offset
key.summary: Roll the hijri date over at the evening adhan
key.description: The hijri day begins at sunset. With this on, the date shown moves forward after the evening adhan rather than at midnight.

key.name: calendar-system
key.summary: Which calendar the month grid is built from
key.description: "gregorian" or "hijri". This is the calendar the page opens on; the page itself can be switched without changing it.

key.name: theme-per-vakit
key.summary: Tint the interface with the current prayer time's colour

key.name: notifications
key.description: Master switch. Which prayer times are announced, and how long beforehand, is in notify-offsets.

key.name: notify-offsets
key.summary: Minutes of warning before each prayer time
key.description: The notification is worth something only while there is still time to act on it, so it is sent before the adhan rather than with it. Per prayer time: -1 silences it, 0 notifies at the adhan itself, any other number is minutes of warning. The defaults match the web app's.
